title: S09T06 - Make the evidence-based technical readiness decision
description: Review automated release gates, compatibility matrices, comparative benchmarks, operational burden, and product differentiation to decide whether the technical hardening milestone is complete or needs a smaller evidence-backed follow-up backlog. This decision does not publish a release.
acceptanceCriteria: The decision records which technical gates passed, failed, or were forced and links the underlying evidence.
A complete decision closes the technical milestone without publishing; any incomplete decision creates a narrower evidence-backed follow-up backlog.
No external user cohort, public publication, or license change is required.
All repository changes are captured in scoped Git checkpoint commits or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health diagnostics are run before closeout.
